caption:
🏥 New clinic? Google first, signboard second.

The last weeks before opening are full: equipment, staff, licences, the board itself. The online setup usually slips to the end, just when people start looking for you.

Word of mouth brings your name. Google is where people check it.

The opening order:
1️⃣ Fix your name and details: one spelling, one address, one phone number, everywhere
2️⃣ Create your Google Business Profile with a future opening date. Google shows it as opening soon about 90 days ahead, once it’s verified
3️⃣ Set up WhatsApp Business with your hours
4️⃣ Publish a simple website: who you are, what you treat, where and when
5️⃣ Get your Instagram bio and first few posts ready

✅ Start with the Google profile: verification can take a while.

🔖 Save this, or send it to a doctor who’s about to open.
